methodology.identity: Test source path plus exact registered test title. Literal titles are extracted from TypeScript/TSX source using the TypeScript parser, then matched to each successful spec-reporter line.
methodology.counting: Select complete final passing logs for persistence, UI, task/clock and engine/planning. From the mixed core log, select only its 33 passing tests/wave0.test.ts identities; exclude 18 successful Wave25/Wave29 duplicates covered by the final clean log and exclude its stale W25-P10 failure. Each source/title counts once. Native browser assertions, typecheck, lint, build stages and parity measurements remain separate.
methodology.mixedLogException: The original mixed core run reported 51 passes and one failure. The 33 passing Wave0 identities are retained as valid evidence. W25-P10 is resolved by the final 19/19 engine/planning run; a new Wave0 run solely for a cleaner log was intentionally not requested.
methodology.scope: Focused Wave29 verification and selected compatibility checks; not a whole-repository test run.
